question.text: 'Aranya Cat II AIF' has total commitments of INR 800 crore. Cumulative drawdowns to date are 40%. LP Mr. Rajesh Bansal has committed INR 20 crore. What is his remaining UNCALLED (committed-yet-undrawn) capital?

explanation.text: The Logic: Called so far = 40% x INR 20 cr = INR 8 crore. Remaining uncalled = INR 20 cr - INR 8 cr = INR 12 crore. This is Mr. Bansal's share of committed-yet-undrawn 'dry powder' at fund level. The Trap: Option A is the called amount (not uncalled). Option C is the full commitment and ignores drawdown. Option D doubles the commitment erroneously. Note: Uncalled capital represents commitments that the Manager can still call upon — investors must keep these amounts available to meet future drawdown notices.
